descriptor: Studio showing generated art sorted by colour

voice.summary: Sounds like a gallery guide with a love of swatches: short, visual, a bit wry. Colours are named precisely, hex codes always shown.
dos: Name colours with a quirky word and show the hex
Describe sorting in verbs: regroup, reflow, copy
Keep titles to three words or fewer
donts: No vague colour words like pretty

taglines: Change your mind, the tiles follow
boilerplate: Spectrum Room is a studio and gallery of small generated artworks that reorder themselves by hue, lightness or title, with every colour one tap from your clipboard.

microcopy.error: That colour could not be copied, try again
microcopy.empty: No works match that hue yet

logo.note: A tile grid represents the swatch wall the brand reorders.
